notes: Prompt universe templates (Phase 19). Placeholders: {city}, {state}, {name}, {competitor}. `market` templates run once per market and score every property in it; `feature` templates are market-level too, keyed by taxonomy topic; `brand` templates are property-specific. `variants` are alternate wordings that cluster with the primary text; only the cluster representative runs routinely and variants rotate. Text is what a renter would actually ask an assistant; nothing here fabricates facts about a property.
